edit.value: ctx contains timestamped log lines like '<ISO8601>Z [ops-note] NOTE author=<name>: <text>'. Operator notes can be found with grep(ctx, r'\[ops-note\]'). Later notes may override earlier ones, so check every match for a given person or topic before answering.

evidence: 2026-03-04T05:10:08Z [ops-note] NOTE author=tomas: Ravi starts parental leave on Monday; Ines will take over his on-call shifts until he is back.
rationale: Records the log format and a grep pattern for operator notes. It also warns that a later note can supersede an earlier one, which helps other questions about ops notes.
